title: ephemeral-controlplane-subnet-allocator-and-signed-endpoint-approvals
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Make private control plane provisioning safer and more reversible for short-lived maintenance windows and cross-account peering. This PR introduces an ephemeral subnet allocator (Terraform module) that can create transient subnets for control plane endpoints, plus a signed endpoint approval flow to reduce blast radius when exposing control-plane endpoints across accounts or regions. Design notes and rollout steps are included below. Changes: 1) terraform/modules/controlplane/subnet_allocator - new module implementing az-balanced ephemeral subnets, deterministic tagging (owner/garbage-collectable:true), and lifecycle policies with TTL metadata that the installer worker can honor; supports dry-run plan output and idempotent reconciliation. 2) installer/scripts/approve_endpoint.py - a small service used by the Private installer that validates endpoint requests, verifies signed approvals created by the operator console, and rotates ephemeral security groups for the endpoint. 3) helm/redwood-private/templates/endpoint-signer.yaml - a Helm chart addition to deploy a signing service used by operator UIs to generate short-lived endpoint approvals (JWT with intended subnet/egress constraints). 4) terraform/upgrade/rollback - helper scripts to perform safe in-place upgrades and to drain ephemeral subnets before deletion. 5) tests/integration/test_subnet_allocator.py - integration tests covering TTL expiry, reconcile loop behavior, and cross-account route propagation. Motivation detail: previously we used long-lived control plane subnets and broad peering rules which made rollback and incident containment cumbersome. This approach provides a measured runway for upgrades: create ephemeral subnets + endpoints, validate traffic, then migrate routes and safely tear down old subnets. Rollback is possible by revoking signed approvals and reattaching old route targets. Checklist: [x] Terraform module with unit tests [x] Helm chart linted & templated [x] Integration tests for reconcile behavior [x] Security review for signer keys [x] Rolling upgrade playbook drafted Testing: local terraform plan/apply against a dedicated test account, end-to-end integration in CI (flaky test marked, retries in the pipeline). Rollout plan: enable feature behind installer flag (PRIVATE_EPHEMERAL_SUBNETS=true), gate by a linear task ENG-4234, start with internal dogfood org, monitor metrics (endpoint connect latency, route propagation errors). Rollback plan: revoke signer keys, delete ephemeral subnets via the rollback helper while forcing route failback, restore previous security group attachments. Related: supersedes parts of SUP-2127 incident mitigation work and lands groundwork for per-endpoint ACLs.

release_notes: Introduce ephemeral control plane subnet allocator (Terraform module) and a signed endpoint approval flow. Enables short-lived control plane endpoints for safer upgrades and cross-account peering. Operators must set PRIVATE_EPHEMERAL_SUBNETS=true to opt-in. See docs/private/ephemeral-subnets.md for rollout and rollback procedures.
notes_for_ops: When enabling on production, ensure operator console deploys signer keys to a secure KMS-managed secret; monitor endpoint_signer.failures and ephemeral_subnet.gc_count. During rollout, expect additional transient routes for up to 5 minutes per region as the reconcile loop migrates endpoints.
